goal: Provide reliable fee rate estimates when mempool policy data is loading, unready, or sparse
Prevent callers from receiving errors or severe underbids during combined fee estimation
agreement: Approach approval for falling back to block policy whenever mempool estimation fails (stickies-v)
Nonblocking objection: sparse healthy mempools should return floor fees rather than fall back (davidgumberg)
Tested and confirmed to fix fee queries when mempool policy is unready (tankyleo, instagibbs)
Approvals on the overall concept and updated approach (achow101, willcl-ark, polespinasa)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it fixes fee estimator errors and relay floor underbidding when mempools are unready
Downstream callers like lightning nodes gain reliable fee estimates instead of query failures
